description: Twelve deterministic, synthetic 96 x 96 scalar-field fixtures for Python/JavaScript topology parity. No observational pixels are included.

connectivity.beta1Rule: complementary ice components that do not touch the image boundary

fixtures.descriptionEn: Smooth, rounded basins with a long correlation scale.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 長相關尺度下形成平滑而圓鈍的盆地。

fixtures.descriptionEn: Shorter correlation length with more small components.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 較短相關尺度帶來更多細小連通分量。

fixtures.descriptionEn: An anisotropic field that favours horizontal corridors.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 傾向形成水平走廊的各向異性場。

fixtures.descriptionEn: The rotated directional counterpart of the ridge fixture.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 脊紋 fixture 的垂直方向對照。

fixtures.descriptionEn: Separated round grains that merge only at high water level.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 彼此分離的圓形顆粒，只在較高水位合併。

fixtures.descriptionEn: A denser Boolean germ-grain field close to coalescence.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 接近合併狀態的高密度 Boolean germ-grain 場。
橢圓顆粒造成方向相關的連通性。

fixtures.descriptionEn: Irregular throat widths expose resolution-sensitive bridges.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 不規則喉道寬度揭示對解析度敏感的橋接。

fixtures.descriptionEn: Large domains after low-temperature deterministic relaxation.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 低溫確定性鬆弛後形成的大型區域。

fixtures.descriptionEn: A warmer relaxation leaves a fragmented morphology.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 較高溫鬆弛保留更碎裂的形態。

fixtures.descriptionEn: Horizontal coupling creates an unseen anisotropic morphology shift.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 水平耦合造成未參與調校的各向異性形態偏移。

fixtures.descriptionEn: Stronger quenched disorder supplies a difficult held-out-style fixture.
fixtures.descriptionZh: 較強凍結無序形成更困難的 held-out 風格 fixture。
